newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Queensland says plans no new taxes in budget.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Queensland says plans no new taxes in budget.

text.p: Queensland state treasurer and deputy premier Joan Sheldon said on Tuesday the state's 1997/98 budget was aiming for no new or increased taxes and charges.

"We will be able to hold to these key parameters, providing the Commonwealth (federal government) does not further cut funding to Queensland and that departments meet their 1997/98 savings targets," Sheldon said in a statement.
Sheldon earlier said the state budget for 1997/98 to June 30 was expected to be delivered on May 27.
